historicalFinding.issue: The Egg-safe living-recipient check exposed the existing residual-before-EXP phase order: a winner at HP1 could lose its earned EXP or level-up survival before poison.

implementedDelta: Per-enemy party participation masks and native single-battle Exp. Share/Lucky Egg/trainer pool planner integration.
EXP and level-up stat/HP changes precede end-turn poison/burn; final action KO checks battle end before residual.
Residual order uses fresh integer stage/paralysis effective speed and its own low-bit tie, retained through the pass; each residual faint is adjudicated before the next.
Actual Battle.start fixtures cover switching/share/divisor reset/level100/cumulative cap and last-KO/level-up/recoil/residual-order cases.
reviewStatus: The historical Opus review remains a finding on514a01e. A separate review of this exact integrated delta is pending; no approval is transferred.
limitations: No rendered-browser verification while automation host is disconnected.
No full DS-global battle RNG draw-order parity.
Speed abilities, held speed/EV modifiers, Trick Room, doubles, real trade acquisitions and simultaneous-last-KO draw policy remain unported or inherited and are not approved by these tests.
The new native Egg hatch lifecycle/view is not integrated by this checkpoint.
